question: What will be the percentage change in NVIDIA (NVDA) stock (NVDA on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-21 to the close on 2026-09-21?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-21 / close on 2026-08-21 - 1), using daily closes of NVDA on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-21, the last close before it is used.
research:
I've pulled together the research for NVDA's move from the Aug 21 close to the Sep 21 close. The starting close is $214.72, and the stock fell another 2.9% on Aug 24. The main event before resolution is the Q2 earnings report after the close on Aug 26. One caveat: page fetches were blocked by the proxy, so every figure comes from search-result summaries and I could not open the sources directly to check them.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on Yahoo Finance's daily NVDA closes ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/)). I couldn't open that page.
- 2026-08-21: StockAnalysis's history table shows the close as **$214.72** (open 218.42, high 218.74, low 214.50, down 0.98% on the day, volume 98.9M). That is the starting price for this question. Yahoo's close should be the same unadjusted number, but I couldn't confirm it directly. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet; almost the whole month-long window is still ahead.
- 2026-08-24: NVDA was down about 2.9% intraday, its 7th straight down day and its longest losing streak since 2022. It was down more than 8% over the streak. From $214.72, a 2.9% drop works out to roughly $208.5, so the stock was already about 3% below the starting price. [ROIC](https://www.roic.ai/news/nvidia-falls-for-7th-day-longest-losing-streak-since-2022-08-24-2026), [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zacharyfolk/2026/08/24/nvidia-stock-tumbles-another-2-pacing-for-seventh-straight-drop-ahead-of-earnings/), [Sweden Herald](https://swedenherald.com/article/nvidia-falls-for-seventh-straight-session-on-wall-street-ahead-of-earnings-report)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: The drop came as tech stocks fell broadly ahead of earnings. Reasons cited in coverage:
  - a reported 15% price increase for some chip customers;
  - tariff threats between the US and Canada, and Iran sanctions;
  - doubts about how long AI demand lasts, plus competition from other chipmakers. [ROIC](https://www.roic.ai/news/nvidia-falls-for-7th-day-longest-losing-streak-since-2022-08-24-2026)
- Week of 2026-08-17 to 08-21: Shares fell about 7%. Investors questioned "circular financing" deals and faced growing political pushback against data-center buildouts. [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4636722-what-changed-in-nvidia-as-stock-fell-7-last-week-bulls-see-these-risks), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/nvidia-shares-dropped-7-week-210044817.html)
- 2026-08-21: A disclosure showed Donald Trump sold $500K to $1M of NVDA stock on that date. That is a trade disclosure, not a price driver. A Motley Fool piece the same day was bullish heading into Aug 26. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/21/prediction-nvidia-stock-will-go-parabolic-after-aug-26-here-are-2-3-trillion-reasons-why/)
- 2026-08-10: Shares lost about $130B in market value on reports that Nvidia had entered a $500B AI financing deal. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/antoniopequenoiv/2026/08/10/nvidia-stock-loses-130-billion-in-market-value-as-firm-reportedly-enters-500-billion-ai-financing-deal/)
- Pre-earnings setup:
  - Nvidia's own Q2 guidance was $91.0B ±2%, with about 75% gross margin.
  - Consensus revenue estimates ran from about $91.9B to $93.6B, with EPS of about $2.09 to $2.13. Visible Alpha's consensus was $92.2B. [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/market-intelligence/en/news-insights/research/2026/08/nvidia-earnings-preview-q2-2027), [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/preview-nvidia-reports-q2-results-today-guidance-implies-revenue-near-91-billion/)
  - Nvidia had beat revenue estimates 13 quarters in a row, but the stock had fallen after each of the last four beats. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/nvidia-to-report-q2-2027-earnings-amid-13-quarter-revenue-outperformance-streak), [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/26/nvidia-has-fallen-after-four-straight-earnings-beats-heres-why-it-could-happen-again/)

## 4. Base rates
- Options implied an earnings-day move of about ±5.3% to 5.4%, roughly a $280B swing in market value. That is below NVDA's average move of about 7.4% over the past 12 quarters (ORATS). Before the May report the implied move was 6.5%. [ORATS](https://orats.com/blog/nvidia-options-280-billion-earnings-swing), [Euronext/Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/nvidia-shares-set-280-billion-price-swing-after-earnings-options-show), [CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nvidia-implied-move-earnings-options/)
- One source says the actual move after earnings has beaten the implied move only about 25% of the time. [earnings-watcher](https://earnings-watcher.com/wiki/nvda-earnings-options)
- I couldn't download price history to calculate exact one-month returns. As a rough estimate, NVDA's realized volatility of about 40% to 50% a year implies a one-month standard deviation of about 11% to 14%. Months that include an earnings report have historically had larger moves, often ±10% to 20%.
- After seven straight down days, the stock was about 8% below its mid-August level going into the report.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market covering this exact Aug 21 to Sep 21 window. Some unofficial aggregator pages list Polymarket weekly NVDA brackets and a market on whether NVDA is above $200 on Aug 31, but I couldn't verify those snapshots or confirm when they were taken, so I'm not using them. [struct.to](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/nvda-above-200-on-august-31-2026)
- One Seeking Alpha piece said options traders were betting on a rebound above $220 after earnings, with puts active around $200. [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4636564-nvidia-options-traders-bet-on-a-bounce-back-above-220-after-earnings)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-26 (Wed): Q2 FY2027 earnings come out after the close, with a call at 5pm ET. The Q3 revenue guidance is the main thing to watch. [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/preview-nvidia-reports-q2-results-today-guidance-implies-revenue-near-91-billion/)
- Late August: earnings from other AI-related companies, plus the PCE inflation report.
- Early September: the August jobs report (around Sep 4) and the August CPI (around Sep 10 to 11). These are approximate dates.
- Mid-September: the FOMC meeting (around Sep 15 to 16), with quarterly options and futures expiration on Sep 18.
- Ongoing risks: export curbs and China, "circular" AI financing concerns, political pushback against data centers, and tariff headlines.
